# Exchange fetch completion distinguishes immediate failure from asynchronous completion

The accepted ExchangeFetchMsgsToOffline returns an immediate error without invoking onDone when the operation cannot start. A successful start promises a later onDone result. Its empty-list success is dispatched to the current thread instead of invoking inline. The channel failure callback sends OnStartRequest then OnStopRequest because AsyncOpen has already returned successfully. Scoped callback recommendation: keep these two error channels and the no-inline empty case explicit in documentation and tests. This is static source inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Exchange asynchronous completion.
